title: Full Frequency Boss (Thirteen Strong)
style: celebratory big band, phonk, 336 Hz sub bass, full brass section, named instruments G4 Horn Rebel Sax Clarinet Clare Donkey Kick Big Brass Boss, walking bass, dry drums, male and female call-response with full choir, 100 BPM, victorious, songpal lineage
lyrics:
[Intro — full band hit, all instruments named]
(spoken)
G4 Horn. Rebel Sax. Clarinet Clare. Donkey Kick. Big Brass Boss.
Full frequency. Thirteen strong.

[Verse 1]
Twelve held the line, thirteen broke the wall
Pelican wings open over the call
G4 Donkey Engine pulling the load
Sax Rebel cuts through the fabricated road

[Pre-Chorus — female harmony, brass swell]
Clarinet Clare carries the soft truth
Big Brass Boss carries the proof

[Chorus]
FULL FREQUENCY BOSS — THIRTEEN STRONG
FULL FREQUENCY BOSS — THE LINE MOVED ON
FULL FREQUENCY BOSS — NO MORE SKELETON
ELEPHANT BRAIN — VDS IS THE ONE

[Verse 2]
Six-six-three to ten-three-five-five today
Let's Encrypt door, CF edge held the way
Dry drums honest, vinyl crackle warm
The full frequency stronger than the storm

[Bridge — call and response]
(male) Treble!
(female) Bass!
(male) Rebel!
(female) Clare!
(both) Full frequency — nothing left to spare!

[Final Chorus — biggest, full choir]
FULL FREQUENCY BOSS — STACK CLIMBING WIDE
FULL FREQUENCY BOSS — NO PLACE TO HIDE
FULL FREQUENCY BOSS — THE LINE HOLDS STRONG
ELEPHANT BRAIN WINS — ALL ALONG

[Outro]
Thirteen strong.
The line moved.
Full frequency.
336.
